note: Compiled from BADAN_MASTER_BLUEPRINT.md by scripts/mine-blueprint workflow. Source of truth for the app registry. (§16-21 Screen blueprint)

screens.name: Onboarding & setup wizards
screens.purpose: An eight-stage, kill-and-resume-safe wizard (Welcome → Platform connect → Backfill+first insight → Tuning → Notifications → Source wizard → Sync choice → Stories) that earns trust and delivers a personal fact in the first session.
screens.casualLayer: Runs to Essential defaults: three-question tuning maps to a Casual preset (labelSet=CASUAL, maxTodayModules=5); every stage after Tuning is skippable to sane defaults; notification 'floor' (morning narrative + weekly digest) is the only default; language/RTL flips live on the Welcome screen.
screens.powerLayer: 'Understand everything' goal + 'show me depth' resolves the Analyst/Power preset; module opt-ins (nutrition, cycle, meds, glucose, biology) trigger their permission bundles; source wizard exposes direct/broker connectors, per-vendor OEM-battery walkthroughs, and BACKGROUND permission; Sync choice offers E2E sync + account, else LOCAL_ONLY first-class.
copyEn: I'll learn your baseline over about 2 weeks — here's what works right now.
What do you want from BADAN? Feel better · Train smarter · Track a health issue · Understand everything
That's all — the morning note and a weekly digest. Everything else stays opt-in.

screens.name: Today root (Home / flagship)
screens.purpose: The daily contract answered in under 10 seconds: how I slept, how ready I am, anything unusual, and one thing worth doing — everything else is curated modules.
screens.casualLayer: Triple-ring hero with one-word drivers, One True Sentence narrative, and at most 5 comfortable-density modules; deviation shown as arrows only; provisional badges and gentle >36h 'data paused' banner; manual-mode hero (subjective check-in + phone steps) when no wearable.
screens.powerLayer: Up to 12 stat-dense compact modules (6-tile dense health monitor, stress/energy, training-today, biology watchlist), arrow+number deviation badges, sparkline axes on tap, tables default-open; long-press module context menu (pin/hide/reorder/explain); same routes, more altitude via PresentationPolicy.
copyEn: Your data's been paused for a while — let's reconnect.

screens.name: Body root & All-Metrics browser
screens.purpose: The single 'your body's data' front door — presence-based pillar cards, repository tools, and inactive-module discovery — backed by the full ~300-entry metric catalog behind curated surfaces.
screens.casualLayer: Shows only 3 active pillar cards (Sleep/Recovery/Strain always present), each a headline stat + status word + 7-day sparkline; inactive modules tucked in a collapsed 'Add more' row; no empty panels — denied pillars show a 'connect data' footer instead of blanks.
screens.powerLayer: Up to 10 pillar cards plus a repository tools row (All Metrics / Raw Data / Data Sources / Export); All-Metrics browser adds has-data/pinned/out-of-band filters and recency/name/deviation sorts, A–Z rail, pinning, and FTS search over names + synonyms.
copyEn: Sleep, 7 hours 12 minutes, in your normal range
No data — tap to learn how to feed this

screens.name: Universal metric detail
screens.purpose: One learnable grammar for every metric — instantiated by metricId from the registry so adding a metric never adds a screen (header → status band → chart → trends → anatomy → resources).
screens.casualLayer: Header value + status word vs personal range + a simple chart; annotation layers default off; rolling-delta 'Trends' table hidden behind 'See trends'; casual labels (precise term in parentheses for first 3 visits); provisional badge with countdown.
screens.powerLayer: Everything default-open: annotation layers (Statuses/Meds/Cycle/Experiments) on, 3/7/14/30/90-day rolling-delta table expanded with meaningful-change flags, sparkline axes, score-anatomy input bars, raw source/method note, compare + export-slice actions; precise labels, numeric confidence.
copyEn: HRV: RMSSD from raw beats, entire-sleep window — change in Calculations
Still learning your baseline — about 9 days to go

screens.name: Unified Timeline (History)
screens.purpose: The anti-fragmentation spine: one chronological, day-grouped, filterable stream of every typed event (sleep, workout, meal, med, symptom, note, status, lab, sync) with infinite back-scroll.
screens.casualLayer: Reached via Today's Timeline preview; clean day headers with day-score micro-rings and simple rows (icon + title + key value + time); filtered-empty and history-start states worded gently.
screens.powerLayer: Multi-select filter chips that compose (meds+symptoms), jump-to-date, and bulk-select mode for tag/delete of manual entries or 'send to Correlation Lab' (auto-ingested rows are provenance-locked and not deletable).
copyEn: No meds events in this range

screens.name: Log hub (the + hub)
screens.purpose: The global logging front door — opens in under 300 ms with a one-handed reach grid of enabled log types plus a personalized recents row.
screens.casualLayer: Rania never needs it (auto-import covers her); when opened it's a simple module-gated grid — no food tile when Nutrition is hidden.
screens.powerLayer: Recents row ranked by frequency×recency prefills flows ('Log Metformin', 'Coffee 250 ml'); long-press on the Log tab skips the hub entirely via a recents radial shortcut; per-type deep links for widgets/watch.
copyEn: What would you like to log?

screens.name: Symptom log
screens.purpose: Under-10-second symptom capture — recents chips to severity and duration, with optional depth (body map, triggers, note/photo) and a vocabulary-chaos guard.
screens.casualLayer: Recents-first chips for 2-tap re-log; a 3-level severity slider (Mild/Moderate/Severe); fuzzy-match prompt prevents duplicate vocabulary; photos stay device-local and out of exports.
screens.powerLayer: 0–10 numeric severity scale (stored normalized with scale-origin preserved), body-map region picker, trigger tags (foods/stress/weather/meds change/custom), onset/ongoing flags, and episode recurrence linking.

screens.name: Medication log (action sheet & hub)
screens.purpose: Non-punitive medication logging: one-tap take-all or per-med take/skip-with-reason from the due list, over a repository hub that states its own no-advice boundary.
screens.casualLayer: Due strip mirrors Today's; overdue reads as a neutral 'still due', never a red alarm; all-taken shows a calm completed state; skipped renders as a neutral outline, not a red X.
screens.powerLayer: Per-slot take-all, skip-reason enum chips with optional note, retro-logging via backdate, PRN handling, watch take-from-wrist parity; hub adds regimen cards, 7-day adherence strip, and regimen-change chart annotations.
copyEn: Skipped — forgot · side effects · ran out · doctor's advice · other
BADAN records your medications — it never advises on dosing.

screens.name: Workout log (quick-add & strength runner)
screens.purpose: Manual 3-tap workout quick-add and edit of imported sessions (S-76) plus a crash-safe strength session runner with per-set logging, plate math, rest timer, and finish summary (S-77).
screens.casualLayer: Quick-add is type + duration + RPE in three taps; imported sessions show source-locked fields with a provenance note; rest-day framing stays neutral ('recovery day', never 'you did nothing').
screens.powerLayer: Full strength runner: template start, steppers pre-filled from last session (≤2-tap repeat set), plate-math popover, superset rotation, mid-session exercise swap, RPE chips, Live-Activity rest timer, and a volume/e1RM/PR finish summary with write-back.
copyEn: A connected device would capture heart-rate detail.

screens.name: Nutrition log (food search & photo-AI review)
screens.purpose: Search-first food logging with all four pathways from one screen (search, barcode, photo, describe), plus a correction-loop review UI that teaches personal aliases.
screens.casualLayer: Favorites/recents/'my usual breakfast' one-tap re-logging; a quick-calories fallback logged honestly as low-detail; passive nutrition state invites a first meal instead of showing 0g/0g/0g; offline logging fully works.
screens.powerLayer: Photo-AI multi-item detection with per-item High/Med/Low confidence chips and ± portion sliders; every correction writes a device-local personal alias that pre-resolves next time; recipe builder with per-serving math; micronutrient dot-matrix and auto-tags (late-meal, high-added-sugar) with uncertainty hints.
copyEn: Detected: flatbread, medium confidence, portion 80 g — adjustable
Search limited — showing your saved and cached foods
Not sure — want to describe it instead?

screens.name: Export Center
screens.purpose: The flagship trust feature's cockpit: format cards, a four-step scope picker, templates, history with checksums, and (Pro) schedules — one-off full-archive exports are free forever.
screens.casualLayer: Reaches curated one-tap versions of the same engine ('Share this week'); template gallery (Physician visit, Sleep study, Training block, Full archive) and simple format cards with size estimates.
screens.powerLayer: Custom four-step scope (metrics/date/sources/options), unit profile + display language, include-suppressed-duplicates toggle, job progress with per-metric resume-after-kill, checksum verify, scheduled exports (RRULE) and personal API; sensitive-class (cycle) inclusion requires an explicit confirm gate.
copyEn: Personal wellness records collected by consumer devices and self-reports; not a medical record; accuracy varies by device.
Include cycle data in this export?

screens.name: Settings root
screens.purpose: The complete configuration tree — one screen deep to everything (account, membership, appearance, modules, calculations, data & privacy, automation, resources) as a modal that X-closes.
screens.casualLayer: Status rows summarize current values with chevrons; module toggles show a live-preview mockup and a consequence warning before any destructive hide; local-only accounts see a calm 'device only' state card.
screens.powerLayer: Per-metric unit overrides (mmol/L↔mg/dL, kg↔lb, °C↔°F), multi-method HR zones, Calculations panel (HRV RMSSD-from-raw-beats, sampling windows) each linking its algorithm page, depth dial with per-surface overrides, notification self-audit, and settings FTS search.
copyEn: Hiding Nutrition disables all related features and screens.

screens.name: Provenance / Source detail (lineage & data sources)
screens.purpose: Per-sample provenance — the full chain plus the dedup decision (S-59) — and the data-sources manager with per-metric source counts, priority ordering, and health monitoring (S-60).
screens.casualLayer: Reached only when curiosity strikes; the lineage sheet reads as a plain vertical chain (device → app → OS store → BADAN ingest → normalization → dedup); Data Sources shows healthy/degraded rows with fix paths.
screens.powerLayer: Dedup decision card naming the winning record and rule, competitor cross-navigation, transform log, and 'copy sample JSON'; Data Sources adds drag-reorder priority that flips dedup tie-breaks (with a visible recompute note) and per-metric hide toggles.
copyEn: Suppressed duplicate of ✓ Apple Watch sample — rule: device-priority

screens.name: Insights / Reports (Coach, digests & annual)
screens.purpose: The interpretation layer's home: expanded narrative and insight feed with evidence links and feedback (S-90), plus weekly/monthly digests (S-32) and the story-format Year-in-Body annual report (S-33) — every claim deep-links its evidence.
screens.casualLayer: Narrative-only reading at a B1 level with a 👍/👎 on each insight; digests arrive as a friendly narrative + key charts + 'what changed' table; provisional framing when baselines are still calibrating; AI-off leaves deterministic narrative intact and hides Ask.
screens.powerLayer: 'Why am I seeing this' shows trigger + evidence + template id; grounded Ask-BADAN Q&A with a non-dismissible grounding footnote and a verifier that refuses to show unverified numbers; deep digest variant and annual decomposition; 'this doesn't match how I feel' feeds perceived-gap calibration.
